handoff.purpose: Rendering helpers for bus records: text processing, fence generation, path derivation, and quorum/evidence extraction.

symbols.name: _text
symbols.note: Converts value to string, returns empty string for None.

symbols.name: _fence_for
symbols.note: Generates backtick fence longer than longest backtick run in input.

symbols.name: _verbatim
symbols.note: Fences text exactly as given with no reflow or escaping.

symbols.name: _short
symbols.note: Truncates digest to first n characters (default 12).

symbols.name: _bus_path
symbols.note: Returns path to bus record; checks transcript then verdict fields, falls back to council_id.

symbols.name: _turns_of
symbols.note: Extracts turn list from transcript, supporting various data structures.

symbols.name: _chain_head
symbols.note: Returns chain head digest from transcript or verdict, falling back to last turn's entry_sha.

symbols.name: _quorum_counts
symbols.note: Returns (answered, requested, answered_vendors, missing_vendors) from verdict.

symbols.name: _evidence_paths
symbols.note: Extracts file paths from verdict evidence and paths fields.

claims.text: A backtick fence longer than the longest backtick run inside ``text``.
claims.why: Function computes longest consecutive backtick run and returns fence length max(3, longest+1).

claims.text: Dissents are reproduced VERBATIM, and a dissent that itself contains a code fence would otherwise terminate ours early -- silently truncating another vendor's objection, which is the one thing this rendering exists to preserve.
claims.why: The docstring explains motivation but the code only computes fence length; actual handling of dissents is elsewhere.

claims.text: Fence ``text`` exactly as given -- no reflow, no escaping, no truncation.
claims.why: Function returns f"{fence}text\n{body}\n{fence}" without modifying body.

claims.text: Where the canonical record lives. Explicit field wins; otherwise derived from the council id, which is how ``bus.py`` names the file.
claims.why: The claim about bus.py naming convention is not verifiable from this chunk; the code implements the field priority and fallback to council_id.

claims.text: A transcript may be the turn list itself, or an object/dict carrying one.
claims.why: Function checks for Mapping, list/tuple, and fallback field extraction.

claims.text: The chain head digest a reader verifies the bus against. Explicit field wins; otherwise the last turn's entry_sha, which IS the head by construction in an append-only chain.
claims.why: Code checks transcript fields, then verdict fields, then last turn's entry_sha.

claims.text: Counts are derived from the vendor LISTS when present, because a list is checkable against the transcript and a bare integer is not.
claims.why: Function extracts vendor lists and uses their length if integer fields are missing.

claims.text: Paths named by the evidence, for the path-marker half of the floor.
claims.why: Refers to 'path-marker half of the floor' which is not defined in this chunk.
